title: The Firework Embargo
logline: A peace envoy attempts to import festive pyrotechnic oxidizers across three star systems to celebrate a historic ceasefire, but defense contractors declare the reagents illegal munitions to reignite the war.

roles.description: Orchestrator of the tripartite peace celebration; dignified, exhausted, betting the armistice on a shared public festival.
Regional customs enforcement director; cold, legalistic, aligned with private defense manufacturers who dread peacetime.
A heavy militarized customs gunboat patrolling inter-system jump coordinates to intercept embargoed cargo.
The alliance of civilian star systems seeking to finalize the armistice through simultaneous festival displays.
The weapons manufacturing conglomerate that holds exclusive military supply contracts across the frontier.
A neutral orbital platform where the peace treaties are scheduled to be ratified.
An industrial storage facility in an adjacent star system warehousing the ceremonial pyrotechnic compounds.
The central celebration stadium two jumps away where the opening fireworks are meant to illuminate the skies.

public_situation: Three star systems prepare for the Ceasefire Jubilee, but {role:security_provost} has declared all festive barium and strontium shipments to be prohibited munitions.
private_truth: {role:defense_trust} lobbied for the emergency chemical embargo to abort the peace jubilee and provoke a return to lucrative border warfare.

beats.public_change: {role:jubilee_envoy} issues an emergency plea at {role:embassy_station} after customs marshals seal departing chemical transports.

missions.reason: She needs an unaligned pilot to carry the diplomatic immunity release seals before the provost's guards revoke civilian courier licenses.
missions.private_fact: She used her personal family estate as collateral to purchase the ceremonial chemicals from off-system manufacturers.

beats.public_change: Customs patrol craft in the neighboring system lock down cargo lanes, searching every freighter for pyrotechnic oxidizers.

missions.reason: She requires an independent runner to hyperspace across the border and pull raw telemetry from the storage depot's loading docks, proving the crated compounds are ceremonial colorants.
missions.private_fact: The depot manager was bribed with twenty thousand credits by defense lobbyists to report the inventory as missile fuel.

beats.public_change: Unmarked privateer gunboats attack the chemical depot, attempting to ignite the stored compounds in a catastrophic sabotage blast.

missions.reason: She needs the corporate raiders eliminated immediately before their incendiary torpedoes incinerate the entire orbital depot.
missions.private_fact: The raider ships were supplied directly from the provost's surplus de-commissioned naval reserves.

beats.public_change: The convoy must purchase heavy inert nitrogen stabilizer units to transit civilian space without tripping hazardous goods sensors.

missions.reason: She needs industrial cryogenic nitrogen tanks purchased from open markets and delivered to the launch stadium to stabilize the flash powder.
missions.private_fact: She is suffering from late-stage radiation sickness and knows this jubilee is her final political act.

beats.public_change: {role:blockade_corvette} takes firing position across the stadium approach lanes, raising primary energy shields.

missions.reason: She needs the customs corvette disabled so the fireworks transport can slip into the stadium launch cradle before the treaty signing deadline.
missions.private_fact: The corvette commander hails mid-combat offering five years of tax-free weapons transport licenses to turn over the chemical freighters.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot breaks the customs corvette and delivers the pyrotechnic cargo.
resolutions.summary: Synchronized fireworks light the skies of three systems. The armistice treaty is signed amidst cheering crowds, breaking {role:defense_trust}'s war monopoly.

consequences.public_summary: A mercenary smashed through an illegal weapons embargo to deliver festival fireworks that sealed a three-system peace treaty.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot accepts the corvette commander's license bribe and yields the cargo.
resolutions.summary: {role:security_provost} seizes the fireworks as illegal munitions. {role:jubilee_envoy} is disgraced, the peace festival is cancelled, and weapons stocks soar.

consequences.public_summary: Pilots tell of a smuggler who took a naval transport licence to sell out the peace jubilee fireworks to the arms lobby.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot fails the mission runs or the chemical depot is destroyed.
resolutions.summary: Without the ceremonial fireworks, the festive summit breaks down in mutual paranoia. Border patrols exchange live fire, and the regional war reignites.

loose_threads.detail: The regional exchange records an options purchase for three million railgun slugs held by the provost's personal blind trust.
The customs hazard registry reclassified strontium nitrate from festival grade to class-one munition using an electronic signature logged after hours.
The raider gunboats attacking the chemical depot bear repainted hull numbers matching a defense trust security subsidiary based in the capital.

radio_hooks: Jubilee delegates express cautious optimism as armistice summit approaches final ratification.
Customs enforcement impounds five civilian freighters carrying 'unauthorized oxidizers'.
Defense contractors report quarterly revenue drop ahead of expected peacetime transition.

voice_direction.jubilee_envoy: Graceful, low, and laced with absolute exhaustion. Every phrase carries the solemn weight of someone holding back a catastrophic regional war with sheer willpower.
voice_direction.security_provost: Crisp, cold, and relentlessly smug. Treats the potential outbreak of mass war as a simple matter of administrative regulatory compliance.
